info.title: OMA LwM2M Edge computing generic condition (Object ID 3439)

Edge_computing_generic_condition.label: Edge computing generic condition
Edge_computing_generic_condition.description: The uCIFI edge computing generic condition object defines a vendor-specific condition (e.g. when a resource or an object is equal to a particular value) at which a particular script should be executed by the device.

Vendor_condition.label: Vendor condition
Vendor_condition.description: Condition described in a vendor specific way.

Script_identifier.label: Script identifier
Script_identifier.description: Object URN/Resource ID of the script to apply to the time/days defined in the vendor condition resource.

Non_supported_time_condition.label: Non supported time condition
Non_supported_time_condition.description: Set to True if the device can’t support the condition.
